parent_dashboard.tips_intro: Suggestions based on how your child actually played. Short, playful practice works best.

tips.start_body: Sit with {name} for the first few rounds. Tips here will become personal once they play.
tips.helper_body: {name} used the helper button {count} times. Before tapping it, ask them to try one more time — praise the effort, not just the answer.
tips.slow_down_body: {name} is answering very quickly but often wrong — this usually means guessing. Ask them to say the answer out loud before tapping.
tips.ready_next_body: {name} gets {percent}% right on the first try. Ready for a new challenge: try {next}.
tips.ready_praise_body: {name} gets {percent}% right on the first try. Celebrate this — a big hug or a sticker goes a long way!
tips.try_new_body: {name} hasn't tried this yet. A new kind of game keeps learning fresh.
tips.routine_body: {name} played on only a few days this week. 10 minutes every day helps more than one long session.
tips.limit_body: Average play is about {minutes} minutes a day. You can set a limit in Controls.
tips.howto_trace: Away from the screen, trace {items} together with a finger in the air, on sand or on paper — always starting from the top dot.
tips.howto_find: Spot {items} together on clocks, number plates and house numbers.
tips.howto_count: Count real things up to {items} — spoons, toys, steps — touching each one as you say the number.
tips.howto_math: Act out {items} with fingers or small toys before playing again.
tips.howto_sequence: Count aloud together, forwards and backwards, and skip-count by 2s and 5s while walking.
tips.howto_pattern: Make {items}s with spoons and forks or coloured blocks, then let your child continue them.
tips.howto_general: Practise {items} together in a short, playful way.

profile.name: Name

focus.early: Focus on recognising, counting and tracing numbers, with simple patterns. Short sessions keep it fun.
focus.middle: Build on counting with ordering numbers, first additions and take-aways, and mixed quizzes.
focus.older: All games on, including multiplication and division, for a full maths workout.

profile.delete_body: This removes the profile from this device. Stars and reports are shared and are not deleted.
profile.delete_last_body: This is the last profile. After removing it you'll need to create a new child profile to keep using the app.
